pages.title: 01 // THE NOISE IN THE SIGNAL
pages.content:
Your mobile phone records GPS telemetry. You walk around a city street. Tall buildings block satellite signals. Your GPS path jumps across buildings, cuts through walls, and zig-zags wildly.

If you render that raw line on a 3D map, the camera violently jerks. VibePath routes raw coordinates through a Python geometry microservice (:8000). The Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm strips point jitter. 3rd-order Cubic B-Splines convert harsh polyline angles into a smooth Coaxial Laser curve (#00E5FF).

pages.title: 02 // REAL-WORLD DISTRICT LIGHTING
pages.content:
How do traditional maps highlight a district? They draw a crude, ugly bounding box rectangle that misses actual administrative borders entirely.

VibePath ingests Mapbox Global Boundaries Vector Tilesets (mapbox.boundaries-adm2-v4). As Stage 3 flight descends, the engine executes a real-time Point-in-Polygon query. It extracts the administrative mapbox_id and illuminates the exact curved municipality boundary with glowing 1px cyan laser borders.

pages.title: 03 // SMART COORDINATE EXTRACTION
pages.content:
Parsing Google Maps URLs manually is a nightmare. Base URLs hide screen camera centers rather than restaurant pins, and shortened links hit CORS blocks.

VibePath's SmartLocationResolver bypasses Google Places API paywalls entirely. It parses hidden !3d latitude and !4d longitude parameters from raw URLs. A Cloudflare Worker proxy pairs with Mapbox Search v6 and Goong API for instant global and local POI resolution with zero personal API keys.
